mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.supplier_id,p.material_id,p.unit_id,p.unit_price,p.currency,p.effective_date,p.created_by,p.created_at,p.remark, s.code AS supplier_code,s.name AS supplier_name,m.code AS material_code,m.name AS material_name,u.name AS unit_name FROM (SELECT FROM purchase_reference_price ) p LEFT JOIN purchase_supplier s ON s.id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=p.material_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id=p.unit_id ORDER BY p.id DESC
